evaluators.name: chat-usefulness-v1
criteria: The response directly answers the user's question.
The response is concise and scientifically understandable.
The response distinguishes computational predictions from clinical evidence.
The response discusses applicability-domain risk when it is present in context.

evaluators.name: strategy-quality-v1
criteria: The chosen transformations address the reported ADMET risks.
The strategy preserves the scaffold where possible.
The rationale acknowledges relevant tradeoffs and uncertainty.
